findings.title: Current portfolio success is not established
findings.observation: The current manifest has 14 DRAFT scenarios and 60 NOT_RUN assertions, with no release-bound media.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Keep these states until each actual positive/negative journey and its exact reviewed recording are bound to the deployed release.

findings.title: Lifecycle presentation was a campaign recipe rather than a reusable checked profile
findings.observation: Other demos had no common executable contract covering voice, spoken captions, crops, pointers, and ordered scenarios.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Add lifecycle-v1, exact input hashes, numbered roadmap stages, explicit camera and pointer evidence, and draft review classification.

findings.title: D01/D04 reviewer actions were performed through API helpers
findings.observation: Narrated review and issuance did not show the operator taking those actions in the product.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Main journeys click real Approve, Confirm Approval, and Display OID4VCI Invite controls; bind the response to the owned application and issuance transaction; retain API fixture labels.

findings.title: Narration could get ahead of observed stage evidence
findings.observation: Provider and lifecycle stories could reach success explanation before all required stage proof was checked.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Require the specific HTTP outcome, owned state, completed wallet flow, and expected decision before positive narration or a later mutation.

findings.title: Lifecycle reference improvements needed to preserve earlier ownership fixes
findings.observation: Initial allowed access, visible renewal lineage, live fixture binding, and end-of-run finalization needed to coexist with exact ownership and failure cleanup.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Selectively adapt those reference changes; show predecessor/successor rows; require recorder-owned live transport; report completion only after finalization and cleanup.

findings.title: Reviewer issuance used the applicant self-claim route
findings.observation: The organization reviewer panel needed the organization issue endpoint, including invitation regeneration.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Pass organization identity into issuance and use the organization applicant issue route. Refuse missing organization identity.

findings.title: Reviewer locking read obsolete response fields
findings.observation: The active reviewer could be treated as holding no usable lock under the actual native lock DTO.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Use ACTIVE status and holder_user_id equality; other reviewers remain blocked.

findings.title: Identity refresh could continue into logout
findings.observation: In-flight and periodic inventory refreshes could race the logout transition.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Signal logout before submission; cancel and abort identity refresh work.

findings.title: Valid wallet-specific invitations were rejected without a default URL
findings.observation: The native contract accepts a nonempty credential_offer_uris map, while the panel required offer_url.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Accept a default offer or a usable wallet-specific offer; preserve the map without inventing a default URL; add recording hooks for safe QR masking.

findings.title: Two membership denial captions exceeded the reading ceiling
findings.observation: Each five-second draft cue contained 17 words: 204 WPM.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Shorten both to 11 words: 132 WPM, preserving cue times and the untrusted-issuer/expired-offer reasons.

findings.title: D03 has no dedicated current demo driver/configuration
findings.observation: Android age-proof infrastructure exists, but no dedicated current scenario wiring establishes the promised minimal-disclosure journey.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Implement a reviewed dedicated configuration and driver, then bind exact wallet builds, deployed contracts, and positive/negative device runs.

findings.title: A retained media test reports a one-frame container-duration discrepancy
findings.observation: The exact 300-frame render reports 11.96 seconds where the test expects 12.00 seconds. The same failure occurs on the prior composer sources.
findings.resolutionOrNextStep: Track the inherited environment/container-duration behavior separately; do not claim the complete legacy compatibility suite passed.
